versions.description_html:
Learn Azure Event Grid in plain English. Discover event-driven architecture, push vs pull delivery, retries, and how it compares to Event Hubs and Service Bus.

Azure Event Grid is the part of Azure that tells your apps what already happened. A file lands in storage, a device connects, an order comes in, and instead of your code asking over and over, Event Grid just delivers the news.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why Event-Driven Keeps Coming Up
  • What Azure Event Grid Actually Is
  • The Four Words You Need
  • Three Kinds of Topics
  • Push or Pull
  • When Delivery Fails: Retries and Dead-Lettering
  • Event Grid vs Service Bus vs Event Hubs
  • A Simple Picture to Keep
  • Recap and One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
